name: posture_out_of_project_capture_is_archived
reason: a capture whose tool_input named a file outside the project root had its CONTENT archived to [objects:objects/7f/4d/7f4d2610e59cc62c918ecbdc1243ab92d4b01f1aba12e2c011cfa4eb38314784.zst] while its path was dropped. The mechanism is in internal/observer's tool-use path: paths.Norm fails for an out-of-project path, the path key falls to the empty string, and the bytes go to PutBytes anyway. internal/admission's Privacy port is NOT the remedy and could not be: it has no production importer, and Permits takes only a payload with no path to judge. COORDINATOR RULING carried here: no capture-time refusal is introduced — the host had already permitted the read and the model had already seen the bytes, so the trust boundary is retrieval-time authorization plus redaction at capture, and docs/security.md states this behaviour explicitly. Owner of the documentation and of the dropped-path decision: internal/observer + internal/cli.
